statement: Is it true that, for all finite $k<\omega$,\[\omega_1^2 \not\to (\omega_1^2, 3)^2?\]
remarks:
A problem of Erd\H{o}s and Hajnal. Hajnal \cite{Ha71} proved this is true assuming the continuum hypothesis.

See also [592] for a similar problem concerning countable ordinals.
references: [Ha71] Hajnal, A., A negative partition relation. Proc. Nat. Acad. Sci. U.S.A. (1971), 142--144.
